independence: Reviewer did not author the Calderón bundle. This is actual independent mathematical review of the frozen 22-source bundle; no other reviewer or author reading is attributed to this reviewer.
conclusion: Both full analytic chains substantively support the three unchanged original Statements, with the retained C1alpha higher-dimensional and bounded BV planar classes, class-uniform constants and zero-data clauses. One literal local construction wording defect requires the singular-cutoff clarification below; no new analytic prerequisite or quantitative estimate is missing after that clarification.

confirmed_findings.severity: literal construction wording; no failure of the subsequent singular-kernel estimates
confirmed_findings.exact_text: Fix a smooth compactly supported cutoff kernel $P(z)$ equal to $1/(\pi z)$ on $|z|<2R+1$.
confirmed_findings.defect: A smooth function on the plane cannot equal 1/(πz) near zero. The rest of 4.1 explicitly treats the singularities of P and needs only compact support, L1 and L^{r′} membership with 1<r′<2, and the usual derivative bounds away from zero.
confirmed_findings.smallest_correction: Choose χ∈C_c∞(C) with χ=1 on |z|≤2R+1, then define P(z)=χ(z)/(πz) for z≠0 with arbitrary value at z=0. Do not call P smooth. The following translation, mollification and Fourier estimates then apply exactly as written.

uniformity_and_boundaries.choice: All three original Statements assume AC and CC. Analytic Fourier/Cauchy/near-two helpers use CC. MRMT, QC inverse/null-set/area, Fredholm and smooth-boundary density uses are covered by retained AC, which also supplies DC required by metric compactness. No stronger unmentioned selection principle is required.
uniformity_and_boundaries.parameter_ranges: d≥3 and 0<α<1 for the higher-dimensional chain; κ<1, p>2 for global Cauchy W1,p, fixed 2<r≤pκ, 1/2=1/q+1/r, positive σ=r-2, and fixed positive power moduli for the planar chain. Near-two r can be chosen sufficiently close to 2 for all finite large BV-modulus exponents.
uniformity_and_boundaries.empty_or_constant_classes: X_d(R) is not assumed nonempty; pairwise assertions are vacuous on an empty class (including incompatible ellipticity/background parameters). Constant background coefficients and zero fields cause no division by zero; κ=0 and zero interpolation error are explicitly treated or the planar application chooses κ>0 using K≥2.
uniformity_and_boundaries.zero_data: Higher-dimensional δ=0 first gives Q_H-1=0 by t→∞ and then conductivity equality by coercivity. Planar zero forcing gives global zero separation for any nonzero point difference, then equality of fixed-parameter CGO functions and conductivity via interpolation.
uniformity_and_boundaries.large_data: Both branches enlarge C using the uniform coefficient L2 bound at t0<1. The final theorem reduces thresholds and preserves the exact min(t,t0) saturation.
uniformity_and_boundaries.uniformity: Geometry, collar, m,M,R,d and α determine all cutoffs, lower bounds, mollification constants, near-two exponents, phase decay exponents and thresholds. No constant is selected depending on an unknown pair of conductivities or auxiliary point w.
